hypothesis: Archetype: precomputed immutable state. _PyPegen_run_parser_from_file_pointer() allocates a fresh PyUnicode '__main__' on every file parse even though the value is static and already available as a global identifier object. Reusing the immortal static '__main__' string with Py_NewRef() may shave file-source parse setup cost without changing warning or error semantics.
